data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root h-s-m which means 'to give'. In Islamic tradition, the name Hishmah is given to signify that the child is a gift from Allah. The name Hishmah carries the meaning “Given by God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hishmah usually hope their child will grow to embody given by god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hishmah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
